definition: The particular pallor — or deliberate lack thereof — cultivated by upper-tier Spire residents who use UV-filtering skinware and controlled-environment living to maintain an untouched complexion. Considered a status marker; ironically, 'Spire tan' means no sun exposure at all — a visible sign that one never needs to go outside.
origin: Satirical street slang from Old Harbor, used with envy and contempt in equal measure
usage: All tiers; lower tiers use it derisively, upper tiers have reclaimed it as a quiet point of pride
example: You could spot the Palladian rep the moment she walked into the Shelf clinic — that Spire tan, smooth as ceramic, not a weather line on her.
